steps.label: Charge qubit
steps.sub: 0/1 = number of Cooper pairs on a tiny island — badly sensitive to charge noise

steps.label: The fix: shunt it
steps.sub: A large capacitor in parallel with the Josephson junction washes out that sensitivity

steps.label: The tradeoff
steps.sub: Less charge noise, but noticeably smaller anharmonicity

steps.label: Why it won
steps.sub: Good noise immunity + manufacturable + still addressable with microwaves

steps.label: Smaller anharmonicity
steps.sub: Typically just a few hundred MHz — a tighter gap to design pulses around

steps.label: A balancing act
steps.sub: Transmon design trades noise immunity against control headroom, not a free win
